stories.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a new cybersecurity model that significantly improves vulnerability finding and fixing, and demonstrates enhanced reliability in staying within authorized scope.

stories.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
stories.explanation: New research indicates that open-weight AI models like DeepSeek and GLM are becoming nearly as capable at hacking simulated networks as OpenAI's advanced cyber model, marking a turning point in cybersecurity AI.

stories.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
stories.explanation: Google is rolling out Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, which offers native 15-second video creation, improved reference adherence, multi-turn conversational editing, and a 30% price reduction, available across the Gemini API and Google Vids.

stories.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
stories.explanation: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the open-source AI hacking tool Artex publicly exposed to the internet, allowing unauthorized access to the penetration testing software.

stories.title: “Does Meta think we can’t read?” Meta abandons sketchy commercial terms update.
stories.explanation: Meta indefinitely delayed plans to update its commercial terms that would have required Facebook page owners to allow extensive AI training on linked content, following backlash from stakeholders.

stories.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
stories.explanation: NVIDIA Vera delivers high throughput and fast agent performance per watt within a single CPU, providing a solution for AI factories to support more agents efficiently without increasing power consumption.

stories.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
stories.explanation: NVIDIA has released four new open-weight checkpoints for its Cosmos 3 model family on Hugging Face, designed for generating interactive world simulations and multi-sensor multi-view driving scenes, under the OpenMDW1.1 license.

stories.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
stories.explanation: Meta introduced 'Spaces,' a new feature for its Muse AI agents that allows users to create custom, topic-focused conversations for collaboration and goal-oriented tasks.

stories.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
stories.explanation: Developers are combining AI agents with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications, test physical behavior, and guide improvements, using natural-language instructions to direct agents and leverage GPU-accelerated physics and rendering.

stories.title: AI Companies Really, Really Want to Buy Your Work Files and Emails
stories.explanation: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are reportedly paying media companies significant sums for internal corporate files and emails to train AI models. This indicates a boom in data acquisition for AI training.
